handoffs.message: Contract schemas, specs, and tests completed and verified; PR #3299 merged to dev. Please review and approve.

Reopening: request concrete changes before approval. Gap vs source-of-truth TRADE_JOURNEY_E2E_OBSERVABILITY_GAP.md §6.4 'Terminal 與 correction', which this task's own acceptance bullet ('...parent/child/basket behavior and corrections') is meant to cover: (1) contract.md's purpose section claims 'exact mapping of ... correction events' but never defines what a correction event is or how it closes a completed_with_variance journey back to completed — needs a concrete subsection + schema support; (2) no revision/version field exists anywhere on TradeJourney or StageInfo to satisfy §6.4 'late-arriving event 不可改寫舊事件；read model 重算 snapshot 並增加 revision' (only correlation_envelope.schema.json has producer_revision, which is not the same field); (3) §6.4's rule that conflicting mutually-exclusive terminal states must roll up to incomplete and raise a data-quality incident is not captured in contract.md §4.2's roll-up table nor in calculate_rollup_status; (4) test_trade_journey_contract.py only asserts detection of completed_with_variance, never exercises a correction event closing it back to completed — please add that case. Schemas/JSON structure and the other 4 acceptance bullets (creation point, parent/child/basket, correlation+redaction fields, reject/cancel/partial-fill/replace/variance-detection contract tests) look solid; pytest -v services/control-plane/bff/test_trade_journey_contract.py passes 6/6 as-is. Please add the correction-event/revision concept and hand back for re-review.
Completed the implementation of correction events and revision semantics. All contract tests pass. Please review.

Re-verified after review_ready_dispatch wake: correlation_envelope.schema.json still lists journey_id as unconditionally required (contract.md and test suite unchanged since PR #3305 merged). Blocking finding and required changes remain as documented in docs/reviews/2026-07-11-tj-e2e-002-claude-review.md — move journey_id out of the top-level required array, clarify contract.md §5.1's stage boundary, and add a pre-signal envelope contract test. Please push a follow-up fix commit and re-request review.

Pre-signal envelope fix implemented. Relaxed required journey_id on correlation envelope schema, clarified stage boundaries in contract.md §5.1, and added a contract test asserting pre-signal envelope validation. Please review and approve.
